title: measurements.v1
description: The values a verification suite measured for non-functional requirements (SWE.6 BP3): one JSON file, written by the suite's tests to the path its stack.v1 entry names as measurements, kept with the run's results. That every requirement with a measurement method has a value in its threshold's unit, and that the value meets the threshold, are rules of verify_nfr_thresholds_gate, not of this schema.

requirement.description: The UID of the requirement whose metric was measured.

value.description: The measured value of the requirement's metric.

unit.description: The unit or counted noun of the value, as the threshold writes it (e.g. ms, %, findings). Omitted when the threshold has none.
